receipt_limit: These are direct-reading notes, not authenticated proof of reading or a complete downloaded-source archive. Read extents are explicit. No raw-source digest is inferred from a URL.

locations: Online written examination and coding test: problem composition
sources.finding: Both divisions cover sections 1–4. Written: 180 minutes, 80 multiple-choice and 10 written responses. Coding: 180 minutes, two tasks.
sources.limitation: Exam composition does not specify course workload, age-based prerequisites, or permitted software for a particular future sitting.

sources.finding: The page distinguishes principles from actual appropriate library use, data application and output interpretation; 60 grouped rows carry separate theory/practical flags.
sources.limitation: The displayed syllabus version differs from the governing competition year. Example names and the plan's expanded obligations must remain distinguishable.

sources.version: Full-scope recalibration; SHA256 pinned in contract.json
sources.finding: The later recalibration retains 120-minute classes, schedules all 60 rows with required outside work and separates optional extensions.
sources.limitation: A schedule is not an execution or mastery record. Prior numeric diagnostic targets and time estimates are not scientifically calibrated thresholds.

sources.finding: The paper operationalizes intended performances and aligns activities and assessment; its teacher-development example distinguishes naming information from applying and relating it.
sources.limitation: A conceptual framework and illustrated teacher-development setting do not establish a randomized KOAI effect; activity choice still needs situated judgment and local testing.

sources.finding: The authors report different effects of example study and generation by element interactivity and prior knowledge.
sources.limitation: This reading obtained the author-repository abstract; do not cite unseen methods or use its results to set local numeric diagnostic cutoffs.

sources.finding: Undergraduates studied science texts with matched initial time; retrieval was compared with elaborative concept mapping and evaluated after a week, including inference questions.
sources.limitation: Science-text learning in that sample does not validate a programming diagnostic, a 10-minute local exercise or 30-minute agent cadence.

sources.finding: The arithmetic mean is computed over the selected axes; default reduction flattens the input, and keepdims changes retained dimensions.
sources.limitation: The built-in reference check below covers rectangular finite two-dimensional inputs with axis 0 or 1 and keepdims false.

sources.finding: Preprocessing is learned on training data. Validation can select settings; final test information must not select them.
sources.limitation: Disjoint row IDs alone do not exclude group, temporal or target leakage. The declared split audit cannot prove absence of all contamination.

sources.finding: Binary precision uses TP/(TP+FP); an absent predicted-positive denominator requires an explicit undefined-value convention.
sources.limitation: Different averaging and positive-label conventions require a separate specification; the reference check is binary counts only.

sources.finding: The study distinguishes intrinsic revision from external feedback and identifies inference-budget and prompt confounds.
sources.limitation: Its older models and reasoning tasks do not establish a permanent inability of later models or outcomes for lesson production.

sources.finding: The work evaluates citation quality separately from other answer properties.
sources.limitation: The paper is a rationale for checking actual support, not evidence that recording a URL authenticates a claim.

sources.finding: The benchmark explicitly includes updated information, temporal reasoning and abstention; preserving original evidence and retrieval keys can matter.
sources.limitation: Conversational memory experiments do not prove that this local dependency graph or deduplication policy is complete.
